takes.text: [low, quiet, waking up] He opens his eyes.
[uneasy, hushed] Bare concrete... on every side.
[slow, steady] Bolted to the floor... a steel desk. A black screen. One chair.
[low] And at the far end of the room... a heavy steel door.

moves.do: pushes himself up on both hands
swings his bare feet down to the stone
walks slowly to the steel door
runs his hand down the seam
steps across to the stone button
jabs it again and again: nothing
pulls the chair out a little
into the gap before the seat
turns his back to the seat
scoots the chair in to the desk
slams both fists down on the keyboard
slouches: hips slide forward, back sinks against the backrest, arms drop limp
startled still: his eyes drop to the cabinet
twists round in the chair towards the cabinet
a rustle inside the filing cabinet
stands up, already turning towards the drawer
turns into it on the second step
bends to the drawer as he arrives, takes its pull
a silverfish bursts out at him
sits up on his right hand, the left sweeps up the pages beside him
leans over his knees for the third
brings them up to his eyes
knees the drawer shut on the way
stands tall: here it is, let's see
glares at the third page on the desk
both hands down onto the desk
flings everything off the desk to his left
drops onto one knee, grabs the pull
down on both knees at the open drawer
up on his knees to read it
up on his knees to read it
up on his knees to read it
up on his knees to read it
up on his knees to read it
up on his knees to read it
tears through the rest with both hands, no longer reading
takes hold of the emptied drawer
pulls it right out and sets it down
steps his left foot forward onto one knee
bends to look into the slot
straightens up on one knee with it

script_lines.text: [slow, quiet] He stands up... and walks toward the door. [tense, hushed] His hand searches along the cold iron edge. Nothing. No handle. Sealed completely from the outside.
[low, focused] On the screen... a test. Task four hundred and twelve. [strained, frustrated] He stares into the code, pushing his mind to find an answer. Nothing comes. The lock is solid.
[exhausted, indifferent] Under the desk, an old iron drawer. Standard manuals. Tools he was told to use. [restless, quiet] None of it helps. He tears through the files, tossing them across the floor.
[whispered, sudden realization] Then... his fingers hit the very back of the drawer. [hushed, chilling] Past the last folder. A folded scrap of paper... wedged into the steel seam.
